positions.title: Software Development Co-op
positions.description:
-Designed and implemented UI and graphical functionality in part studio features such as mate highlighting, feature coloring, and part isolation, working mainly with Angular and WebGL
-Wrote and modified WebGL shader code to expand highlighting and transparency behavior
-Researched and presented demo on WebAssembly and possible integrations with the product

positions.title: Software Developing Co-op
positions.description: Co-op in R&D modeling team.  Developed features for the part studios and assemblies in the web-based CAD software.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Worked in the Synergetic Media Learning Lab, which focuses on visual machine learning.  Collected and labeled data for an action recognition dataset involving visual, skeletal, and EMG data to be published for public use.  Wrote code to organize and store the data collected.  Corrected and verified research papers before publication.

volunteerExperiences.description: Assisted attendees and answered questions during virtual presentations
Created public artwork (such as murals, sculptures, and posters) to raise environmental awareness.  Themes included carbon emissions, wasteful habits, and recycling.
